name: waterloo-docstrings
description: VS Code tools for writing, validating, and generating Waterloo docstrings in Python.

waterloo.showSuccessNotifications.description: Show information notifications after successful Waterloo actions.

waterloo.ignoreList.markdownDescription: Rule IDs ignored by Waterloo validation warnings. This maps to `waterlint validate --ignore` semantics.

waterloo.mcpProvideServer.description: Add a Waterloo MCP stdio server to VS Code.

waterloo.mcpCommand.description: Command VS Code should run to start the Waterloo MCP server.

waterloo.pythonExecutable.description: Python executable used by the extension for the backend and MCP config discovery.

waterloo.mcpConfigPath.description: Path to wtrl_mcp.stdio.toml. If empty or relative, VS Code also looks in the open workspace and in the installed Waterloo package etc/ directory.

waterloo.mcpServerLabel.description: Name shown for the Waterloo MCP server in VS Code.

commands.title: Waterloo: Save and Check Coverage of Docstring

editor/context.when: resourceLangId == python && editorTextFocus && waterloo.backendReady && waterloo.cap.any && waterloo.isFuncClassOrModuleLine

waterloo.context.when: resourceLangId == python && editorTextFocus && waterloo.backendReady && waterloo.cap.generateMinimalDocstring && waterloo.isFuncClassOrModuleLine
resourceLangId == python && editorTextFocus && waterloo.backendReady && waterloo.cap.generateFullDocstring && waterloo.isFuncClassOrModuleLine
resourceLangId == python && editorTextFocus && waterloo.backendReady && waterloo.cap.validateDocstring && waterloo.isFuncClassOrModuleLine
resourceLangId == python && editorTextFocus && waterloo.backendReady && waterloo.cap.validateCoverageDocstring && waterloo.isClassOrModuleLine
